svg.text: Founder's podium — the corner office, 1.2 m
James's deck — a step down, along the west wall
Billy's plaza — in the mix, facing the lens
Studio floor: five pods of four
Woven team islands on an oak floor
Garden bay: bench, planting, low lattice
Open to the walk grid (half-metre cells)
- - - the way in, and the two lanes by Billy
━ glazing (the camera sees S and E)
Soft shared light · screens emit no face light
Hero stations retained. A stone gallery connects leadership, support and operations; Billy anchors the avenue; a planted bay opens the east edge. North up; camera from SE.
